div.note: K is from B (Cambridge, Corpus Christi College 383, p. 42, after Ine but as a new piece, same hand, c. 1125); the heading is in red, and the ‘um’ of ‘morðslihtum’ was cut off in binding. H (Textus Roffensis f. 31b, as the end of Ine, c. 1120); its heading stands not before the text but in the Af–Ine rubric list on f. 11, and the number CXXI should be struck. The Quadripartitus heading is only in its youngest recension, probably not original. Liebermann dates Blaseras c. 930–75.; F: corrected against Liebermann, Gesetze I (date in the running heads), October 2026 (was “c.930–75; ?mid 990's (Wormald)”, now “c.930–75 (Liebermann); ?mid-990s (Wormald)”)
